top_violation_types.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Precautions for Swimming Pools - Bottom Clearly Visible (26 TAC §747.4801(7))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The water in the pool is not clear and you cannot see the bottom of the pool.

top_violation_types.title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Document ion verifying household members had orientation to the home was unavailable for licensing to review.

top_violation_types.title: Fence Gates Around Swimming Pool - Self-closing/ Self-latching/Locked (26 TAC §747.4807(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The pool does not have self-closing or self-latching hardware. A picture was taken.

top_violation_types.title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for during the emergency.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have written policy for procedures for the release of children, illness and exclusion criteria, procedures for dispensing medication a statement that medication is not dispensed, procedures for handling medical emergencies, discipline and guidance policy, safe sleep for infant 12 months old or younger, the procedures for parents to visit the child-care home any time during your hours of operation to observe their child, program activities, the home, the premises, and equipment without having to secure prior approval, the procedures for parents to review copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online, instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the DFPS website your emergency preparedness plan, procedures for conducting health checks.

top_violation_types.title: Safety Precautions for Swimming Pools - Lifesaving Devices (26 TAC §747.4801(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The pool does not have 2 life saving devices.

top_violation_types.title: Swimming Pools - Chemicals and Pumps Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.4801(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has a pool and the pool pump is accessible to children in the outdoor play area.
